1. **Download the Analysis Batch**

title: Fix for corrupted WebViewV2 files
text:
# Fix for corrupted WebViewV2 files:
- Firstly, go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft
- Then delete the folder named "EdgeWebView"
- After that, copy the "Edge" file into the same folder you are in right now. Now you will have a folder named "Edge - Copy"
- Rename that "Edge - Copy" folder to "EdgeWebView"
You are good to go now!

title: Add exclusions on Windows Security
text:
# How to add exclusions on Windows Security:
## Firstly, open Windows Security.
Navigate to Privacy & Security → Windows Security → Virus & threat protection
## Secondly, go to Exclusion Settings.
Click "Manage settings" under Virus & threat protection settings. Then, scroll down to the Exclusions section. Click "Add or remove exclusions". Press yes when prompted to give administrator permissions.
## Thirdly, add the Folders:
### Adding C:/Users/%username%/Downloads:
Click "+ Add an exclusion"
Select "Folder" from the dropdown
In the folder path bar at the top, type:
`C:/Users/%username%/Downloads`
Click "Select Folder"
### Adding %LocalAppData%/Madium/Bin:
Click "+ Add an exclusion"
Select "Folder" from the dropdown
In the folder path bar at the top, type:
`%LocalAppData%/Madium/Bin`
Then, press enter and click "Select Folder".
### Adding %temp%:
Click "+ Add an exclusion"
Select "Folder" from the dropdown
In the folder path bar at the top, type:
`%temp%`
Then, press enter and click "Select Folder".
## You are good to go now!
Video attached as well to make it easier for you to understand how to do it.
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/873778414371368993/1495743508676481094/How_to_put_exclusions.mp4

title: Exclusions for inbound/outbound requests
text:
# How to put exclusions for inbound and outbound requests in your firewall
## Video attached with it at the end, read both texts and watch the video to understand how to do it.
## Opening firewall
- Search Firewall on the windows search bar.
- Open "Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security"
## Inbound requests
Press **Inbound Requests** on the left sidebar
Then press **New Rule** on the right sidebar
### The next process will repeat 3 times for each path:
1. Select program then press next;
2. Put the path of the program then press next;
3. Press allow the connection and press next;
4. Make sure all options are checked/tick-marked: Domain, Private and Public | After that press next
5. Add a name according the .exe file that you selected from that particular path.
### All 3 paths for **Inbound Requests**:
- C:\Users\Your Username\AppData\Roaming\Madium\Bin\Loader.exe
- C:\Users\Your Username\AppData\Roaming\Madium\Bin\Madium.exe
- Location of where you put your madium-launcher.exe, find it through the browse section.
## Outbound requests
Press **Outbound Requests** on the left sidebar
Then press **New Rule** on the right sidebar
### The next process will repeat 3 times for each path:
1. Select **Program** then press next;
2. Put the path of the program then press next;
3. Press **Allow the connection** and press next;
4. Make sure all options are checked/tick-marked: Domain, Private and Public | After that press next
5. Add a name according the .exe file that you selected from that particular path.
### All 3 paths for Outbound Requests:
- C:\Users\Your Username\AppData\Roaming\Madium\Bin\Loader.exe
- C:\Users\Your Username\AppData\Roaming\Madium\Bin\Madium.exe
- Location of where you put your madium-launcher.exe, find it through the browse section.
Video tutorial on how to do it: https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1486058139508932608/1495916476425568416/How_to_put_firewall_exclusions.mp4?ex=69e7fc48&is=69e6aac8&hm=8e987970a7

title: Fix webview related issues
text:
# How to fix Webview related issues:
**1. Grant Folder Permissions**
- Press `Windows Key + E` to open File Explorer.
- In the address bar, type: `C:\Users\%username%\`
- If a pop-up prompts you for access, click **Allow** or **Continue**.
- Restart the application.
## Not so recommended fixes but can work (suggest only doing these if was 1. done perfectly and didn't work)
### 2. Navigate to:
`%localappdata%/Madium`
Right-click the folder "WebView" and select Properties.
Go to Security, allow Read and Write permissions, then click Apply.
### 3. Alternative method:
Navigate to `%LocalAppData%`
Right-click the folder named Madium and select Properties > Security tab.
Scroll down to the Group or usernames box and highlight Trusted Installer.
Click Edit, then check the Read and Write boxes if they are unchecked.
